description: HP-69 is the official code for the Regional Transport Office (RTO) in Bilaspur, Himachal Pradesh. It handles various transport-related functions including vehicle registration, commercial permit issuance, and driver licensing oversight for the district. It functions as the main administrative transport office alongside local Registration & Licensing Authorities (RLA) like HP-24.
